abstract: This paper constructs an overlapping generation model that integrates endogenous marital formation and parental human capital investment decisions to characterize the joint determination of the distributions of family structure and college attainment. We use the model to examine the effects of public policies that reallocate college enrollment opportunities based on students’ social and economic status. We find that such policies may equalize college enrollment rates but lower college completion rates, marriage rates, and overall welfare. These outcomes arise from distorted parental investment incentives and a shift in family composition toward single and non-college-educated households, which invest less in children’s human capital relative to households with college-educated parents. These findings highlight disparities in the family structures in which children grow up as a fundamental source of inequality in college education.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个融合内生婚姻形成与父母人力资本投资决策的世代交叠模型，用以刻画家庭结构与大学教育成就分布的联合决定机制。我们利用该模型考察了基于学生社会经济地位重新分配大学入学机会的公共政策效应。研究发现，此类政策虽可能使大学入学率趋于均等，但会降低大学毕业率、结婚率及整体福利水平。这些结果源于父母投资激励的扭曲，以及家庭构成向单亲及非大学教育背景家庭转变，这类家庭相对于拥有大学教育背景父母的家庭，对子女人力资本的投资较少。这些发现凸显了儿童成长所面临的家庭结构差异，是大学教育不平等的一个根本性来源。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: A tale of two families: marital formation, parental human capital investment and college attainment
title_zh: 两个家庭的故事：婚姻形成、父母人力资本投资与大学教育获得

abstract: Joint information blocking is the strategic behavior of a group of buyers that blocks competitors’ information. In the framework of diffusion auctions, joint information blocking employed by buyers’ tacit collusion can avoid competitive bidding, which leads to inefficiency of the auction mechanism. In this paper, blocking-proofness is introduced and investigated. Blocking-proofness means that buyers cannot benefit from joint information blocking, that is, from deleting diffusion relations to other buyers in the network. It is shown that blocking-proofness and incentive compatibility are independent, and both are necessary conditions for collusion-proofness. Finally, the blocking-proof diffusion auctions with monotonic allocation policies are fully characterized, and the independence of the conditions is discussed.
abstract_zh: 联合信息封锁是指一组买家采取的策略性行为，旨在阻碍竞争对手获取信息。在扩散拍卖框架下，买家通过默契合谋实施联合信息封锁，可规避竞争性报价，从而导致拍卖机制效率低下。本文引入并研究了防封锁性这一概念。防封锁性意味着买家无法通过联合信息封锁获益，即无法通过删除网络中与其他买家的扩散关系来获利。研究表明，防封锁性与激励相容性相互独立，且两者均为防合谋性的必要条件。最后，本文完整刻画了具有单调分配策略的防封锁扩散拍卖，并探讨了各条件的独立性。
title: How to prevent joint information blocking: A study of blocking-proof diffusion auctions
title_zh: 如何防止联合信息封锁：防封锁扩散拍卖研究

abstract: A vocabulary is a list of words designating subsets from a grand set X . We model a vocabulary as a partition of X and study the aggregation of individual vocabularies into a collective one. We characterize aggregation rules when X is linearly ordered and each word of the vocabulary spans an order interval. We allow for individual vocabularies to differ both in the number and in the span of their words. Under a suitable restriction on agents’ preferences, we show that our aggregation rules are strategy-proof.

abstract_zh: 词汇表是从一个全集X中指定子集的词语列表。我们将词汇表建模为X的一个划分，并研究如何将个体词汇表聚合为集体词汇表。当X具有线性顺序且词汇表中的每个词语覆盖一个序区间时，我们对聚合规则进行了刻画。我们允许个体词汇表在词语数量和覆盖范围上存在差异。在对个体偏好施加适当限制的条件下，我们证明这些聚合规则是防策略性的。这是订阅内容的预览，请通过机构登录以检查访问权限。

abstract: ABSTRACT Cage‐free egg production systems, in addition to its namesake, include pasture‐raised and certified organic eggs. Rising consumer concerns about animal welfare have increased demand for these options, yet little is known about the extent to which consumers understand these product distinctions and how information may influence their beliefs and willingness to pay. This study used an incentivized, artefactual field experiment to elicit preferences and beliefs regarding hen welfare, environmental impacts, and nutritional quality across production systems, both before and after information provision. The results indicate that information attenuated beliefs about the welfare and nutritional benefits of cage‐free systems, while increasing beliefs about various benefits of pasture‐raised and certified organic eggs. Price premiums increased for pasture‐raised eggs and decreased for cage‐free and conventional eggs.
abstract_zh: 摘要 无笼鸡蛋生产系统，除其名称所示外，还包括牧场散养和认证有机鸡蛋。消费者对动物福利日益增长的关注提升了对这些选项的需求，然而，关于消费者对这些产品差异的理解程度以及信息如何影响其信念和支付意愿，目前知之甚少。本研究采用一项激励性的、人工实地实验，在信息提供前后，分别引出了消费者对不同生产系统下蛋鸡福利、环境影响及营养品质的偏好和信念。结果表明，信息削弱了关于无笼系统福利和营养益处的信念，同时增强了对牧场散养和认证有机鸡蛋各种益处的信念。牧场散养鸡蛋的价格溢价上升，而无笼鸡蛋和常规鸡蛋的价格溢价则下降。
title: Does Information Change Consumer Beliefs and Valuation of Cage‐Free Egg Systems? Evidence From an Artefactual Field Experiment
title_zh: 信息是否改变了消费者对散养鸡蛋系统的信念和估值？来自人工实地实验的证据

abstract: International trade in natural resource commodities has been tied to declining socio-environmental conditions in production locations. Increasingly, governing bodies have turned to unilateral traceability programs to harmonize environmental and social standards at the production local with those of the importer. The United States’ Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP) is one such program that covers the largest seafood import market by value and aims to reduce imports of seafood products from Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated fishing or that are fraudulently labeled. We evaluate the impact of the SIMP on import prices as an indicator of program costs and supply chain changes. Comparing observed import prices to forecasts of counterfactual prices in a causal impact framework, we find an average 13.55% increase in import price, or a lower bound $411 million increase in import value, in the first year of implementation. Examining potential heterogeneity, we find variation in the timing of impact across processed and unprocessed products. Impact also differs across species groups. Observed significant price increases for some tunas and crustaceans likely reflect cost pass-through and changes to sourcing decisions aligned with program goals. Our findings suggest that unilateral traceability programs can be costly but support socio-environmental sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自然资源类商品的国际贸易与生产地的社会经济环境恶化密切相关。为协调生产地与进口国之间的环境和社会标准，越来越多的管理机构转向实施单边可追溯性计划。美国的《海产品进口监控计划》（SIMP）便是其中之一，该计划覆盖了按价值计最大的海产品进口市场，旨在减少来自非法、未报告和无管制（IUU）捕捞或标签欺诈的海产品进口。我们评估了SIMP对进口价格的影响，以此作为项目成本和供应链变化的指标。在因果影响框架下，将观察到的进口价格与反事实价格预测进行比较，我们发现实施第一年进口价格平均上涨13.55%，即进口价值至少增加4.11亿美元。在考察潜在异质性时，我们发现加工和未加工产品在影响时间上存在差异，不同物种组之间的影响也有所不同。部分金枪鱼和甲壳类动物观察到的显著价格上涨，可能反映了成本转嫁以及与项目目标一致的采购决策变化。我们的研究结果表明，单边可追溯性计划虽可能带来成本，但有助于支持社会经济环境的可持续性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
title_zh: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据
